newsitem.title: UK: Boots rises on stronger sales.
newsitem.headline: Boots rises on stronger sales.

text.p: Shares in Boots Co rose on Monday after the UK retailer and chemist reported comparable sales rose six percent in the quarter ended December 31, 1996.
The shares added 7p by 0939 GMT to 618-1/2.
In a statement, Boots said the group's overall performance was satisfactory, but Christmas sales were slow nLDT3053.
Yet the increase in sales during the company's fiscal third quarter came as a relief amid widespread concerns about the retail sector's weaker-than-expected Christmas season, said one market maker.
